title: Prove sharp support29 rank-six P112 A3 shortening
body:
## Summary

Prove sharp P112 A3 shortening over every characteristic-zero field, uniformly over orthogonal punctures:

```diff
 four binary-rank-six endpoints, independent pieces
- common small support <=22: code intersection dimension <=2 (PR3221)
+ common small support <=29: code intersection dimension <=2
+ common support 30: literal counterexample, intersection dimension 3
```

The new singleton-defect budget accounts for missing mandatory coordinates and nonmodal shifts. It needs no special common six-flat cover. Only `research/p112-a3-support29/` changes: proof, exact witness, source pins, replay and controls. Task `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, priority revision 6; changed scope and next caller question are explicit in TASK.json.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3221's equality argument stops at 22; PR3227 has a special six-flat-plus-four contract.
  **After:** all 25 defect cases exclude support 29; an actual independent-piece witness at 30 has exact rational ranks 34/8/39 and intersection 3.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay passes all 788,035 six-flats,2,025 punctures and 14 behavioral groups. The separate checker reconstructs roots/labels, checks all 17,472 eleven-label subsets, regenerates punctures and directly checks budgets/witness. It does not independently re-prove six-flat capacity, full singleton closure or Weyl classification.
- Read-only Git-free CPython 3.13 replay passes with `-O -W error -B`; Ruff and all 15 committed publication-byte comparisons pass. CHECKS.json preserves outputs, environments and hashes. Internal mathematical/code reviews found no remaining blocker after corrections.

Reproduce from the repository root (full command and external-output setup in README.md):

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -W error -B \
  scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-a3-support29
```

Exact contribution commit: `bd90899d5a45806288f7f3c9f177172a0ef5fa59`; canonical main remains `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19002664).

Credit Nick Petalas/PR3221 and PR3227, DreamingOfClouds/PR3154, and the retained E8/P112 lineage including joaqcoo. All predecessor heads and hashes are pinned. Development used substantial automated assistance. This is author-checked evidence, not independent human or proof-kernel review. The standard Weyl-chamber theorem remains a written dependency. No new historical profile, full C5, decoder floor, supplier or kappa is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One new research package; selected result, frozen inputs and shared code are unchanged. No supplier admission is requested.
